entities.name: Large amine substrate
observations: Decoded component 1 is NC(=O)OCC1=C(C(=O)OC(c2ccccc2)c2ccccc2)N2C(=O)[C@@H](N)[C@H]2SC1 and contains a free primary amino group.
The free amino nitrogen is the coupling nucleophile in the inferred reaction.

entities.name: Large acid substrate
observations: Decoded component 2 is O=C(O)/C(=N\OCC1CC1)c2csc(NC(c3ccccc3)(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)n2 and contains a carboxylic acid.
The carboxyl carbon is the electrophilic center activated by oxalyl chloride.

entities.name: Predicted amide product
observations: Predicted product forms an amide between the acid carbon of the large acid substrate and the free amino nitrogen of the large amine substrate.
Calculated formula is C50H44N6O7S2; calculated molecular weight is 905.07 Da.
The newly formed bond is between the acid carbonyl carbon and the free amino nitrogen.

entities.name: Oxalyl chloride amide coupling
observations: Oxalyl chloride activates the carboxylic acid, with DMF as activator/catalyst and N,N-dimethylaniline as base or acid scavenger in dichloromethane.
The reaction is consistent with one-pot conversion of the acid to an acyl chloride followed by amide formation.
